title: Modular Sign Compensation for MIMO Systems with Unknown Control Direction: An Exact Nominal Recovery Approach
summary: This paper addresses stabilization of MIMO systems with uncertain time-varying diagonal input direction. We propose a modular switching sign-compensation layer acting as an outer wrapper around a nominal controller. Unlike Nussbaum-type gains, monitoring functions, or binary adaptive mechanisms, the method uses only bounded sign changes that preserve the nominal control magnitude and its properties.
